experimental_means: False only means the dataset-level error was within the band on at least 4 of the 6 datasets. It is not a reliability claim: the band is the leave-one-dataset-out RMSE used for model selection, not a prediction interval.
applies_to: English queries, indexes up to about 171K documents
training_protocol: 306 fits: six model pairs, rows 6, 8 and 8b, K 1,024, 2,048 and 4,096 (NFCorpus, at 3,633 documents, has no 4,096), seed 0 only, lead-sentence proxies, full-length anchor documents. One protocol, and no configuration repeated
fitting_code: scripts/calibrate_quality.py at commit 1deac9b (2026-10-31), the commit that shipped this file
reproduced: 2026-11-05: scripts/calibrate_quality.py, as revised for the review, refits every coefficient, mean, scale and band bit for bit from the training sources
